# Love Maze - 8-bit Maze Game

## Project Overview
An 8-bit style maze game themed on love with peppy background music. Players navigate through mazes to reach the endzone and progress to the next level.

## Technical Stack
- Python 3.x with Pygame
- 8-bit pixel art aesthetic
- Heart-themed graphics
- Chiptune/peppy background music
